name: Wavelet Transform
definition: Defined by Monet Morlet [18] to avoid the fixed resolution limit of windowed Fourier transforms. It decomposes the signal into a family of functions, which are the translation and dilation of unique ip{x).
summary: The Wavelet Transform decomposes volumetric data into a multiresolution hierarchy of coefficients, offering spatially localized frequency analysis that avoids the block artifacts of DCT and provides orientation selectivity unlike Laplacian pyramids.
